en: Vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑tinted) postcard view of a town street labeled "Kötzschenbroda. Bahnhofstrasse." It shows a row of 2–3‑story buildings with shops, signs, and a hotel along a raised sidewalk overlooking a broad street or square. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk, children play, and a bicycle leans against a railing. In the distance a prominent corner building bears a large sign for a café and billiards. In the foreground stands a cylindrical advertising column surrounded by iron railings.
